purpose: The repo's setup script needs a tool that only its declared image installs. In a container the audit builds that image and the app reaches Level 2. With no container runtime and no yes to host mode, nothing runs: Level 1 is unproven on this machine and the evidence says why. Host mode's handling of the missing tool is covered in tests/units.test.ts.

runs.name: no container runtime
runs.diagnosis: not run: host mode wasn't allowed
